create_cuda_graph_runner: create a MultiLayerEagleDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner for a given eagle worker and step to capture CUDA graphs for speculative decoding
run_cuda_graph_capture: run CUDA graph capture for multi-layer eagle draft extend with batch sizes and torch compile configuration
replay_cuda_graph: replay a captured CUDA graph for a forward batch with padded or unpadded batch size handling
build_multi_step_runner: build a MultiLayerEagleMultiStepDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner that manages per-step CUDA graph runners for speculative decoding
check_cuda_graph_compatibility: check if a forward batch can run on the captured CUDA graph with supported batch size and MLP sync requirements
